material_composition: Ceramic-composite hardwood frame with synth-leather upholstery
short_description en: The flagship of the Orion Collection, this sofa pairs command-deck poise with vacuum-tested comfort.
description en: The centerpiece of the Orion Collection, this sofa combines a ceramic-composite frame with alloy-mesh support over a titanium-frame core. Sized for the widest habitat lounges and certified for artificial gravity. Dimensions: 220x95x85cm. Load capacity: 500kg (fully-suited crew welcome).

material_composition: Alloy-mesh frame with crimson synth-leather covering
short_description en: Finished in deep crimson, this Nebula Heritage sofa brings warm color to any orbital lounge.
description en: A signature piece of the Nebula Heritage line, this sofa stretches deep-crimson synth-leather over a ceramic-composite frame with alloy-mesh support. The cushioning soaks up impact like a soft docking maneuver. Dimensions: 210x90x82cm.

material_composition: Titanium skeleton with deep-space charcoal synth-leather panels
short_description en: Dark and modular, this Umbra Collection sectional keeps storage as neatly as it keeps comfort.
description en: A modular sectional from the Umbra Collection. Each segment interlocks with titanium joints that conceal hidden storage compartments, accented with subtle meteorite inlay. Charcoal synth-leather over a ceramic-composite frame. Dimensions: 280x100x90cm.

material_composition: Cryo-tempered titanium frame with textured synth-leather
short_description en: Built for the cold reaches, this Borealis Frontier sofa rides out any temperature swing in comfort.
description en: Built for the outer stations of the Borealis Frontier, this sofa pairs a cryo-tempered titanium frame with a ceramic-composite shell and textured synth-leather. Spill-proof cushioning included. Dimensions: 225x92x88cm.

material_composition: Fortified ceramic-composite shell with shock-absorbing interior
short_description en: Solid as a docking clamp, this Outpost Line sofa is an unshakeable anchor of comfort.
description en: Engineered to Outpost Line tolerances, this sofa features triple-layered ceramic-composite reinforcement, alloy-mesh support and modular expansion, finished with meteorite inlay. Each section is a station unto itself. Dimensions: 300x110x95cm.

material_composition: Sensor-integrated alloy-mesh frame with auto-adjusting cushions
short_description en: Smart-guided, this Magnetar Line sleeper sofa optimizes rest efficiency by 47.3%.
description en: The Magnetar Sleeper Sofa integrates simple sensor subroutines to auto-adjust cushion firmness and temperature across its alloy-mesh frame. Nano-chrome control pads on each armrest fine-tune comfort at a touch. Dimensions: 230x95x86cm.

material_composition: Ceramic-composite frame with contoured synth-leather
short_description en: A command chair worthy of any flight-deck officer on the station.
description en: Designed for long shifts on the flight deck, this Orion Collection chair offers lumbar support calibrated for fully-suited crew and integrated armrest data-slate holders on a ceramic-composite and titanium frame. Dimensions: 65x85x70cm.

material_composition: Graphene-finished hardwood with impact-rated cushioning
short_description en: Quick-deploy seating for busy docking-bay and mess situations.
description en: Lightweight stackable chair designed for rapid deployment in galley and docking-bay scenarios. Graphene-finished legs resist scuffs from magnetic boots, with an alloy-mesh back for airflow. Dimensions: 50x90x55cm.

material_composition: Heavy ceramic-composite frame with multi-position reclining mechanism
short_description en: Full-recline seating platform with superior all-round visibility and easy adjustment.
description en: The Zero-G Recliner features a heavy ceramic-composite frame rated for sustained daily use. Its nano-chrome multi-position mechanism reclines to near-weightless observation angles. Part of Heliox Works. Dimensions: 72x105x80cm.

material_composition: Lightweight alloy-mesh frame with anodized-gold accents
short_description en: Low-profile lounge chair optimized for long stretches on the observation deck.
description en: From the Eclipse Edition, this low-profile chair pairs an alloy-mesh back with anodized-gold accents and near-silent adjustment on a ceramic-composite frame. Ideal for quiet viewing galleries. Dimensions: 68x80x72cm.

material_composition: Anodized-gold frame with contoured comfort padding
short_description en: An executive office chair fit for long shifts of station administration and planning.
description en: From the Quasar Series, this office chair features anodized-gold armrests and ergonomic support for extended paperwork sessions, with nano-chrome detailing. Built-in holder for a data-slate or logbook. Dimensions: 58x110x60cm.

material_composition: Precision-balanced titanium frame with vibration-dampening cushions
short_description en: A precision swivel chair tuned for navigators and long console watches.
description en: From the Solaris Collection, this chair features vibration-dampening cushions and a titanium frame that resists fatigue over long watches. Ceramic-composite base with 360-degree swivel for full console coverage. Dimensions: 62x95x65cm.

material_composition: Standard-issue ceramic-composite ottoman with cargo-pod motif
short_description en: Standard-issue footrest, station-approved for any authorized rest period.
description en: Produced in bulk for the Orion Collection, this ottoman features regulation-grey upholstery and a cargo-pod embossed lid on a ceramic-composite shell. Form 27B/6 required for requisition. Dimensions: 60x45x60cm.

material_composition: Utility-pattern ottoman with integrated tool storage
short_description en: Neat and clever, this storage ottoman conceals a full tool kit under the lid.
description en: A Heliox Works ottoman featuring integrated storage compartments lined with magnetic tool racks. The nano-chrome lid bears a drone-dock emblem in bas-relief. Oil-resistant synth-leather standard. Dimensions: 65x48x65cm.

material_composition: Sealed-pattern ottoman with lockable interior compartment
short_description en: A compact ottoman with a lockable hold. Contents strictly your own.
description en: Eclipse Edition ottoman featuring a bio-locked compartment accessible only via keycard authentication. Its unassuming ceramic-composite exterior belies a surprising storage capacity over a titanium frame. Dimensions: 55x40x55cm.

material_composition: Round ottoman with soft-cushion top and integrated tray
short_description en: A round ottoman built for easy, restful downtime anywhere on the station.
description en: Part of the Solaris Collection, this round ottoman doubles as a floor cushion on a ceramic-composite base. An integrated tray holds a mug or reader, and a starburst motif is stitched in gold thread. Dimensions: 60x42x60cm.

material_composition: Graphene-finished frame with bio-gel recovery mattress
short_description en: A platform bed designed for deep, restorative sleep on long-haul voyages.
description en: Designed for the cryo-bays of the Borealis Frontier, this bed features a graphene-finished frame and a bio-gel mattress that speeds recovery. Weight-rated for full crate storage beneath, with nano-chrome fittings. Dimensions: 210x120x160cm.

material_composition: Sleek graphene-finished nightstand with soft-close drawer
short_description en: A refined nightstand with a secure drawer, fit for any captain's cabin.
description en: A Quasar Series nightstand featuring a graphene-finished surface and a bio-locked drawer. The top is etched with a fine star-map pattern. Dimensions: 50x60x45cm.

material_composition: Nano-chrome-detailed dresser with multiple deep storage drawers
short_description en: A premium-quality dresser with generous, deep storage capacity.
description en: This Outpost Line dresser features six reinforced drawers, each rated for heavy garment and gear storage. Nano-chrome detailing on the handles and graphene-finished corners. Dimensions: 150x85x50cm.

material_composition: Void-sealed wardrobe with modular garment rack system
short_description en: A wardrobe designed for freighter quarters with full garment rack integration.
description en: Void-sealed Heliox Works wardrobe featuring a modular rack system compatible with all garment types. Emergency vacuum-seal preserves contents during a hull breach, framed with meteorite inlay. Dimensions: 120x200x65cm.

material_composition: Compact vanity with integrated mirror and grooming surface
short_description en: A compact vanity optimized for tight corvette officer quarters.
description en: Designed for the confined quarters of a corvette, this Eclipse Edition vanity features an integrated mirror with built-in lighting and a graphene-finished surface with nano-chrome trim. Dimensions: 105x75x55cm.

material_composition: Graphene-finished desk with integrated holo-display surface
short_description en: A command-deck desk with integrated tactical displays for any station chief.
description en: The Command Deck Desk features an integrated holo-display surface for real-time coordination. Titanium-reinforced legs anchor a graphene-finished top with meteorite inlay, built for the Quasar Series. Dimensions: 180x125x80cm.

material_composition: Regulation writing desk with built-in inventory log holder
short_description en: A writing desk built to the exacting standards of any quartermaster.
description en: Regulation Solaris Collection writing desk with integrated log holder and a tally counter. Its graphene-finished surface resists ink and spills, with nano-chrome fittings. Dimensions: 120x75x65cm.

material_composition: Reinforced bookshelf with lockable restricted section
short_description en: A sturdy bookshelf with sections for both open and restricted archives.
description en: This Outpost Line bookshelf features a lockable restricted section and reinforced lower shelves. Capable of housing everything from crew manuals to sealed star-charts, framed with meteorite inlay. Dimensions: 90x180x35cm.

material_composition: Graphene-finished filing cabinet with magnetic data-wafer sealing
short_description en: A precision-built filing cabinet for secure data-wafer storage.
description en: Precision-machined Heliox Works filing cabinet designed for the storage and retrieval of data-wafers. Nano-chrome magnetic sealing prevents unauthorized access and interference, over a graphene-finished body. Dimensions: 45x70x40cm.

material_composition: Weather-hardened lounger for exterior observation decks
short_description en: A hardened lounger for extended duty on exterior observation decks.
description en: Designed for solar-deck watchstanders, this Eclipse Edition lounger withstands harsh exposure including radiation and micro-debris on a ceramic-composite frame with meteorite inlay. Integrated holder for recaf mugs. Dimensions: 180x85x90cm.

material_composition: Reinforced bench for promenade seating and equipment staging
short_description en: A reinforced bench built for promenade seating and busy thoroughfares.
description en: Standard Borealis Frontier bench rated for full-row seating. Doubles as a staging platform for crates during resupply, with a graphene-finished, hard-wearing underside. Dimensions: 150x90x60cm.

material_composition: Impact-resistant chair for habitat-dome installations
short_description en: An impact-resistant chair for habitat-dome and airlock operations.
description en: Magnetar Line seating rated for sudden pressure shifts. An integrated restraint harness prevents ejection during decompression events, with a graphene-finished shell and nano-chrome frame. Low profile fits snug bays. Dimensions: 85x50x85cm.

material_composition: Master-crafted throne with full smart-integration suite
short_description en: A master-crafted throne for the chief engineer with full smart integration.
description en: The ultimate expression of Magnetar Line craftsmanship, this custom throne features full smart-integration data-ports and a self-adjusting frame that responds to the occupant's posture. Each unit is individually calibrated by a chief engineer. Dimensions: 70x120x75cm.
